blocks.heading: 01 · Incident response · 24 nodes
blocks.text: Signals converge through correlation and triage, while a legacy NOC still pages responders and receives command-side updates. Automation, vendor escalation and public communications rejoin at verification before the learning loop closes.

blocks.heading: 02 · Regional billing · 32 nodes · nonplanar
blocks.text: Three regional ingress services each call tax, foreign-exchange and fraud policy, forming an explicit K3,3 core. A legacy billing service still writes invoices directly, while payment retries and reconciliation feed shared ledgers and finance operations.

blocks.heading: 03 · Freight operations · 40 nodes
blocks.text: Quotes, bookings and tenders move through a long freight lifecycle. The legacy TMS writes orders directly, carrier tenders retry, customs and warehouse services share documents, and live tracking fans out to operations and customers.

blocks.heading: 04 · Data platform · 48 nodes
blocks.text: Operational sources enter through change capture, files and events, then split across quality, streaming and batch paths. A legacy warehouse still receives direct extracts, shared catalog and identity services span the platform, and failed loads loop through replay before serving products and governance sinks.
